findings.title: The three feature notes read as an afterthought

location.description: The row of three short notes under the thin rule, below the headline and the plan.

findings.viewer_experience: The viewer's eye stops at the plan and the main button; the three notes below are small, close in weight to body text, and followed by a large empty area, so the features that make the product concrete are easy to miss.

current.value: The three note headings are set only slightly larger than their text, in a thin row under a hairline, with about 100 pixels of empty page below.

findings.target: The three notes read as a deliberate part of the page, and each heading is easy to find.
findings.fix_direction: Give the row of notes more weight and a clearer place in the reading order of the page.

closed_when.check: Look at the lower part of the page and check that the three feature notes read as a deliberate part of the page.
